Document with only style tags produces empty output (styles are stripped)

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "html_to_markdown.h"

int main(void) {
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<html><head><style>body { color: red; }</style></head><body><style>.foo { margin: 0; }</style></body></html>", 0);
    htm_conversion_result_free(result);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
